trials.instruction: Grab the white coffee mug, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Grab the ceramic mug, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Pick up the cylindrical mug, rotate it, place it on the table, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Grab the mug with rounded bottom and handle on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the printed beige mug on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the medium-sized rack.
Pick up the matte black mug, rotate it, place it on the table, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Lift the beige mug from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Pick the beige coffee mug from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Pick up the ceramic mug, rotate it, place it on the table, and hang it on the dark gray rack with flat back.
Lift the beige mug from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the dark gray rack with flat back.
